whatItFakes: The Nation heading on News tells every law another state passed in the last nationNewsDays, not the ones a reader would care about.
why: Which other-state laws reach a player's attention needs an interest rule from the owner (the places the player has lived, the topics in their drives); until then a plain window over the records shows the country moving without a cap or a chance.
replacement: Resolved Nov 8 (State Sessions, the CTO's Nov 6 ruling): src/bench/nation-news.ts tells a law when its state's share of the nation times one plus the reader's family, work and neighbor ties clears nationNewsReachBar; the data is src/core2/data/places/state-reach.json (Census population and county adjacency).

whatItFakes: The Nation heading's reader ties are family, work and a neighboring state; a state the reader moved from is not a tie.
why: A person keeps no record of the places they have lived (no moved-from field in people or the life engine), so the tie cannot be read.
replacement: Dropped Nov 10, 2026 (too in depth, owner): the estimate stays as the game's answer. Was: Read the reader's past homes once the people engine records them, and add it as a fourth term beside family, work and neighbor (nationNewsMovedTie).
resolvedBy: stand-in triage T9 (owner, Nov 10: too in depth)

whatItFakes: The paper's round-birthday and retirement briefs read only the town's full residents; a counted resident who turns 80, 90 or 100, or who retires, gets no notice.
why: A birthday notice names the person, and a counted resident has no name until the player meets them. Filling one in for the paper would make the press decide who exists.
replacement: Dropped Nov 10, 2026 (too in depth, owner): the estimate stays as the game's answer. Was: A person a brief names is a named person, so the counted resident whose round birthday falls in the week is filled in, seeded from the world, when the notice prints (two-level population; the CTO, Nov 1, the same rule the lives lead uses), and the week's round birthdays are read from the counted population's ages by place by the same rule as a full resident.
resolvedBy: stand-in triage T9 (owner, Nov 10: too in depth)

whatItFakes: Only full readers write letters to the editor: a counted reader of the outlet never does.
why: A letter is written from a stance the reader's last story moved, and a counted reader's view is not moved by what they read (views.ts countedLean), so no counted stance cites a story to answer.
replacement: Dropped Nov 10, 2026 (too in depth, owner): the estimate stays as the game's answer. Was: The CTO's rule (OWNER-DECISIONS Nov 1 20:00): counted readers are weighed by the same press.letter rule, times their count, from their view on the story's question and their temperament, and the writer a printed letter names is filled in, seeded, when it prints.
resolvedBy: stand-in triage T9 (owner, Nov 10: too in depth)
